historical_reviews.deepseek: HTTP codes for one endpoint cannot prove all inventory objects or values.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Correctly restores endpoint breadth and rejects the literal credential, while expected payload fields, timing and load policy remain project inputs.
historical_reviews.related_cases: Same-code row152 is a separate NIC variant. This row is read-only management-plane stress, not firmware update or HMC functional load.
historical_reviews.v3_1: Run a credential-safe 100-by-11 request matrix with immutable endpoint identity, canonical payload comparison, latency/error trends and pre/post management/SEL/OS health.

original_test_intent: Prove repeated reads of every specified HGX firmware inventory object remain correct and do not destabilize BMC management or generate stress-related platform errors.
original_method: Resolve BMC/TLS/credential and exact 11-member inventory contract; capture baseline payloads, BMC health, SEL and OS logs; execute 100 numbered cycles over every member with approved pacing and bounded timeouts; retain status, latency and canonical response body for all 1,100 requests; compare stable identity/version/status fields while excluding approved volatile fields; stop on authentication, HTTP, latency or health thresholds; re-query all members and correlate post-run SEL/OS logs without clearing them.
manual_activity: Owner supplies secret/TLS policy, expected inventory and approved load window; the agent can execute and evaluate the bounded read-only matrix.
required_inputs: BMC identity, Redfish version and exact availability of all 11 HGX inventory members
Secret injection and certificate/TLS trust policy
Per-member expected Id/Name/Version/Status and allowed volatile fields
100-cycle order, concurrency/pacing, request timeout, total duration and latency/error aborts
SEL and OS log sources/time synchronization plus management-health oracle
safety_requirements: Never use or reproduce the literal source password; redact authentication material
Do not use `-k` unless explicitly approved; record certificate policy
Bound rate, concurrency and timeout; stop on 401/403, repeated 5xx/timeouts, rising latency, BMC instability or critical logs
Retain all response bodies and failures; do not discard bodies or clear logs
Do not restart/reset BMC or retry an unstable run automatically
agent_execution_scope: Execute the approved 1,100 GETs using secure secrets and collect cycle/member/status/latency/body evidence
Canonicalize approved stable fields and correlate BMC/SEL/OS health
Do not guess endpoints/versions, expose secrets, mutate firmware, clear logs, restart services, retry automatically or decide PASS/FAIL
engineer_actions: Approve endpoints, credentials/TLS and expected payload matrix
Review full matrix and issue verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Severe coverage loss: 100 requests to BMC_0 with `/dev/null` bodies cannot cover 11 members or verify firmware information.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Nested loop over cycles 1..100 and the exact 11-member list using secure authentication; persist status, latency and JSON body per request and compare canonical fields to the approved matrix.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: All 11 literal member IDs, 100 cycles, BMC/SEL/OS health, per-cycle correctness, Common branch, Script reference and 30/720-minute scope are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Execute a complete bounded 100x11 inventory-read matrix with canonical payload and management-health comparison.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds secure credentials, TLS, timing, persistence, canonical field rules and stop conditions without reducing requests.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: HTTP 200 alone cannot prove correct firmware identity/version, and BMC_0 alone is 1/11 of source coverage.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Repeated GETs are non-mutating but can overload a weak service; inventory values may contain legitimate volatile metadata.

project_override_considerations: Do not conflate this variant with same-code row152. The internal Script must cover all members and never embed credentials.
expected_evidence: 11-member expected field matrix and baseline JSON
Per-member success/error/latency summary and canonical mismatch report
Pre/post BMC responsiveness, SEL and OS event-log correlation
Abort/recovery evidence if applicable and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure and Criteria coherently require all listed inventory members for 100 cycles and correct/stable management behavior.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Credentials, expected payloads and load policy are normal project gates; the read-only method remains conditionally executable.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Reliability row154 variant 4eeefc2767f9fa49 (not same-code row152): confirm the 11 Redfish member IDs and per-member expected Id/Name/Version/Status plus volatile fields; approve secure credential/TLS policy, curl and pinned Script revision, 100-cycle request order/concurrency/pacing/timeouts/latency and HTTP aborts, pre/post BMC responsiveness and SEL/OS log oracle, and recovery without automatic BMC reset/retry.

review_improvement: Restores the omitted 10 endpoints and discarded firmware payloads, protects secrets and defines a complete observable load/health contract.
independent_technical_reasoning: The source workload is 100 cycles across 11 distinct resources, so the historical loop executes only 1/11 of endpoint coverage and discarding JSON makes the correctness criterion untestable. Repeated success codes can coexist with stale, swapped or incomplete firmware objects. Each request therefore needs endpoint/cycle identity, canonical content and timing, while BMC/SEL/OS state must be compared around the bounded load. The shared code cannot import NIC semantics from row152.
